description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Priest of Gix, adding {C}{C}.
When Priest of Gix dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Priest of Gix on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Priest of Gix from the top of your library by paying {2}{B}.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.
